caveats: Candidate is the host's own quarantined trajectory; the archive holds no repaired candidate for this window, so A3 can only accept or reject the host poses.
Incumbent is a constant-velocity extrapolation, not a per-frame record, so the paired test asks whether the candidate beats 'no repair', not whether it is optimal.
A0 and A2 write the identical keyframe set and therefore the same map; A2 differs only in having passed through quarantine before admitting everything.
ATE on the admitted set is confounded by coverage; ate_on_common_support is the like-for-like number.
